title: Implement generic bounded SplitMix64 integer sampling with rejection proof and deterministic regression
commitMessage: feat: implement bounded unbiased SplitMix64 integer draws

contribution.summary: Implement and qualify a generic versioned unbiased bounded integer transformation for SplitMix64, including exact counter, budget and checkpoint behavior.
contribution.value: Add two bounded methods to the existing noncryptographic SplitMix64Random, preserving raw generator vectors, and target independent exhaustive 8-bit rejection proof, forced raw-word rejection, output boundaries, signed extremes, typed invalid-input and counter refusals, replay and existing statistics regressions. Do not pack or publish.
debtChanges: RS267 succeeded attempt 001 after two preselection refusals; its first-pass indicator is false. Canonical M9 backlog v0.1.124 and native planned hierarchy are admitted.
RS268 implements only M9 T1 source behavior and bounded tests. A new immutable Statistics candidate, source-free net11 binary consumer, rights and publication remain separate gates.

RS268 initial invocation refused before attempt allocation: MSTEST0032 on a compile-time constant assertion. Corrected test via reflected version field and fixed the full-range signed golden oracle; no product implementation changed.
contribution.nextAction: Build a nonpublished versioned Statistics NuGet candidate and independently consume its new bounded API using a real net11 PackageReference; only then assess authorized publication.
